nodes.description: Constructor that mints total supply to msg.sender, sets owner and infinite allowance to the UNI router.
Public payable transfer that forwards execution to transferFrom using msg.sender as sender.
Internal view whitelist gate checking owner, UNI constant, computed pair, tradeAddress and canSale before allowing a transfer.
Public payable transferFrom performing unchecked allowance/balance mutations and _onSaleNum increment after ensure().
Public payable allowance setter keyed by msg.sender.
Internal view sale restriction checker using _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum.
Owner-only function that performs an arbitrary delegatecall with user supplied bytes.
Privileged mint/whitelist function gated by owner or a hardcoded address, sets canSale[spender].
Owner-only initialization of sale limits with unchecked scaled multiplications.
Owner-only batch transfer using unchecked total computation and duplicated Transfer events.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Internal pure CREATE2-style pair address computation with hardcoded init code hash.
Private owner address used for privileged modifiers across the contract.
Public balance mapping mutated with unchecked arithmetic.
